paragraphs: I am fascinated by what human beings are capable of, and by what makes that capacity available to them.

That question has run through everything I have done. I spent years as a professional dancer and choreographer across Europe, work that is entirely about what a body can be brought to do and the conditions under which it will do it. Then I ran my own businesses: hired, fired, opened, closed. Then coaching, and a long study of human development, philosophy and contemplative practice. It is the same question each time, asked in a different material.

I work with founders and owners, and with senior people inside larger organisations. For more than seven years I have worked alongside people making decisions that rarely have clean answers, and building things that did not exist before. I have navigated what founders navigate, and I bring that directly into the work.

I trained in somatic practice, shiatsu and martial arts, and have logged several thousand hours in meditation. I have led retreats, taught on stages and in studios, and coached leaders internationally. So when you are in the room with me, I am not looking at one dimension. We work on the whole person, the whole business, and the whole life.

Most people in high-stakes roles think they have to choose. But do you? Can you be playful and drive results? Can you keep a lighthearted smile and perform? From an early age, I rejected that either-or, the belief that your private wants and your working life can't get together.

I live between the Alpstein and the Bodensee with my wife, Jae. I write regularly, with a deep interest in philosophy, science, business, and the human condition. I'm ICF PCC-certified, with training in leadership coaching, ACT therapy, business development, and contemplative practice.
experienceIntro: Alongside founders and owners, I coach professionals inside large organisations: a global industrial gases and engineering group, a US software company, a Swiss cantonal pension fund, and an Austrian tax advisory firm.
certifications: International Coaching Federation, Professional Certified Coach (PCC)
